properties.displayName: Azure - Privileged RBAC Role Assignment Created
properties.description: [Added 2026 threat-model expansion] Detects successful Azure control-plane role assignments for Owner, Contributor, User Access Administrator, or Role Based Access Control Administrator. These assignments materially increase resource or access-management privileges.
properties.query:
let PrivilegedRoleIds=dynamic([
 '8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635',
 'b24988ac-6180-42a0-ab88-20f7382dd24c',
 '18d7d88d-d35e-4fb5-a5c3-7773c20a72d9',
 'f58310d9-a9f6-439a-9e8d-f62e7b41a168'
]);
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where OperationNameValue =~ 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write'
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ('Success','Succeeded')
| extend Props=todynamic(Properties_d), PropsText=tostring(Properties_d)
| extend RoleDefinitionId=tolower(coalesce(tostring(Props.roleDefinitionId),extract(@'roleDefinitionId[^0-9a-fA-F]+([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})',1,PropsText))),
         PrincipalId=coalesce(tostring(Props.principalId),extract(@'principalId[^0-9a-fA-F]+([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})',1,PropsText))
| extend RoleGuid=tolower(tostring(split(RoleDefinitionId,'/')[-1]))
| where RoleGuid in (PrivilegedRoleIds)
| extend RoleName=case(RoleGuid=='8e3af657-a8ff-443c-a75c-2fe8c4bcb635','Owner',
                       RoleGuid=='b24988ac-6180-42a0-ab88-20f7382dd24c','Contributor',
                       RoleGuid=='18d7d88d-d35e-4fb5-a5c3-7773c20a72d9','User Access Administrator',
                       RoleGuid=='f58310d9-a9f6-439a-9e8d-f62e7b41a168','Role Based Access Control Administrator','Privileged')
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, PrincipalId, RoleName, RoleGuid, ResourceId, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup, CorrelationId
